description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for managing address book entries and provides a local implementation that interacts with a local data source. It includes methods for listing, adding, updating, deleting, and setting default addresses, along with seed and clear operations.

classes.name: AddressBookRepository
classes.description: Abstract interface defining the contract for address book repositories, including methods for address management.

classes.name: LocalAddressBookRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of AddressBookRepository that manages addresses using a local data source.

methods.name: listAddresses
methods.description: Returns a list of all addresses, sorted with default addresses first and most recently updated first.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a specific address by ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address after validation, managing default address status.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address, maintaining default address logic.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Deletes an address by ID, promoting another address to default if necessary.

methods.name: setDefaultAddress
methods.description: Sets a specified address as the default.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds the address list with a default address if it's empty.
